name: ssh-mcp
description: MCP server exposing policy-gated, audited SSH access for Linux and Windows hosts via the Model Context Protocol.
long_description: Runs commands, sessions and SFTP transfers on remote hosts behind a role-based policy engine and an approval gate. Destructive and privileged commands are classified and gated rather than trusted. Secrets are never passed as command-line arguments. Configure a single host in the fields below, or point at a TOML config file for multiple profiles, roles, policy rules, command quotas, tamper-evident audit and OpenTelemetry traces. See the README for the full flag and configuration reference.

config_file.title: Config file (TOML)
config_file.description: Path to an ssh-mcp config.toml. Leave blank to use the platform config directory. A config file is required for multiple profiles, roles, policy rules and the streaming file tools (transferRoot).

host.title: Host (quick start)
host.description: Single-host quick start. Ignored when a config file is used.

user.title: Username (quick start)
user.description: SSH username for the quick-start host.

port.title: Port
port.description: SSH port for the quick-start host.

key_path.title: Private key file
key_path.description: Path to the private key. The path, never the key material.

password.title: SSH password
password.description: Prefer an SSH agent or a key. Stored in your OS keychain and passed to the server as an environment variable, never on the command line.

passphrase.title: Key passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase for the private key above, if it has one.

sudo_password.title: Sudo password
sudo_password.description: Used by privileged-command when the policy allows the privileged class. Piped via stdin, never visible in the process list.

tools.name: list-connections
tools.description: Discover available hosts and connection status.

tools.name: open-session
tools.description: Create a named interactive (stateful) or background session.

tools.name: close-session
tools.description: Close a session, signalling a background session's command first.

tools.name: run-command
tools.description: Execute arbitrary commands, gated by the approval policy.

tools.name: privileged-command
tools.description: Execute with sudo, gated by the approval policy.

tools.name: sftp-list
tools.description: List a remote directory, bounded in entries and bytes.

tools.name: sftp-upload-file
tools.description: Stream a local file to the remote host, never through model context.

tools.name: sftp-download-file
tools.description: Stream a remote file to local disk, never through model context.

tools.name: signal-process
tools.description: Send INT/TERM/KILL to a remote PID.
